parent_blueprint.name: Synthetic identity trust build and bust-out
parent_blueprint.description: A low-history synthetic persona establishes ordinary payment behaviour before a sudden, bounded series of high-value transfers and cash-outs.
parent_blueprint.objective: Build sufficient legitimate-looking history to make the later behavioral transition a realistic bust-out stress case.

sequence.description: Create a new synthetic persona with a bounded account-age proxy.
Emit spaced, moderate, explicitly legitimate warm-up activity.
Leave a configurable delay before the behavioral transition.
Concentrate elevated transfers and cash-outs into a short window.

warmup_transaction_count.name: warmup_transaction_count
warmup_transaction_count.description: Legitimate transactions used to establish behavioral history.

warmup_amount_mean.name: warmup_amount_mean
warmup_amount_mean.description: Target mean for bounded warm-up amounts.

warmup_amount_stddev.name: warmup_amount_stddev
warmup_amount_stddev.description: Warm-up amount dispersion before realism clipping.

account_age_days.name: account_age_days
account_age_days.description: History proxy at the beginning of observable warm-up activity.

parameter_evidence.rationale: Credible Round 0 evasions showed positive risk contribution from temporal.amount, temporal.amount_deviation_from_source_history; test a bounded decrease move. Attribution supports exploration, not a causal efficacy claim.
Mapped signals temporal.seconds_since_source_previous_txn, temporal.source_velocity_1h did not provide a consistent risk-increasing direction; no directional conclusion is asserted.
Credible Round 0 evasions showed positive risk contribution from temporal.destination_velocity_1h; test a bounded increase move. Attribution supports exploration, not a causal efficacy claim.
Mapped signals temporal.source_avg_amount_before did not provide a consistent risk-increasing direction; no directional conclusion is asserted.
Credible Round 0 evasions showed positive risk contribution from temporal.source_txn_count_before; test a bounded decrease move. Attribution supports exploration, not a causal efficacy claim.

notes: Round 0 contains one parent parameter region; signal attribution is associative, not a cross-region parameter correlation.
